topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can't believe it, I just found out. That tree, the one we planted together, you remember? With the little sapling in our hands, dreaming it would grow as big as our dreams. It's... it's gone. Just like that. They cut it down. All that time, watching it grow taller, shading us in the heat, it was like watching a friend bloom. Now, just a stump. It feels like someone took a piece of us and just... just erased it. I don't know what to do, I keep thinking if I go back, maybe it’ll still be there, like a mirage. But it’s real, isn’t it? What do we do now?
